distribution: Taiwan, Fujian, Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Jiangxi, Hunan, Guangdong and Hainan.
soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule rather sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.60–0.71, the sides nearly parallel and slightly diverging posteriorly, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The frontal ridge is slightly raised, the interfrontal area nearly flat. The labrum is spear-shaped, its apex passing from narrowly rounded to sharply rounded, with apical, subapical and lateral-apical hairs all present. The mandibles are sabre-shaped, the mandibular body rather straight, the apex of the right mandible almost not curved, that of the left mandible slightly curved, their length 0.59 of the head capsule length and 0.93 of the head width. Antennae with 16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, the anterolateral margins nearly trapezoidal, the waist region rather broad with the two sides in a broad arc, the waist constriction index 0.36–0.44. The pronotum is about 1.57 times as wide as long, the anterior margin formed by two broad intersecting arcs and shallowly concave at the middle, the posterior margin nearly straight with the middle slightly concave, the lateral margins like an inverted trapezium, with more than twenty hairs in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.
